question: "Wide Angle" is an autobiography of which of the following sportsperson?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anil Kumble.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Wide Angle" is an autobiography written by Anil Kumble himself.**
 
• Anil Kumble is a** former Indian cricketer and a former captain of the Indian cricket team.**
 
• He was one of the **best spin bowlers in the world and is known for his accuracy and consistency.**
 
• Kumble is also the third-highest wicket-taker in Test cricket and the only Indian bowler to take all ten wickets in a Test innings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wasim Akram** is a former Pakistani cricketer and one of the greatest fast bowlers in the history of cricket.

 
 
• He has also written an autobiography named** "Wounded Tiger".**
 
 
 
• **Yuvraj Singh **is a former Indian cricketer and a left-handed all-rounder.
 
 
• The Test of my Life is an Autobiography of Yuvraj Singh.
 
 
 
• ** Imran Khan **is a former Pakistani cricketer and the current Prime Minister of Pakistan.
 
 
• He has written an autobiography named "All Round View".
